xmldoc.short_description: Turn the per-signal struct into one matrix, a column per signal.

param_output_item.param_description: a struct with samples (N x L), rate (the top rate), leads (1 x L cellstr), units (1 x L cellstr), gain and baseline (1 x L) and spf (1 x L samples per frame).

description.p: Turns the per-signal struct R from wfdb.read into one matrix, one column per signal, every column at the same rate. The samples are whatever R holds, raw or physical, so the physical choice is made once, at the read.

A signal recorded slower than the fastest (a multi-frequency record) is held sample by sample across the frame so the columns line up, and its column takes the top rate; a signal shorter than the record (a stitched gap) is padded with NaN so its column keeps the record's length. A single-rate record is just stacked. A caller that needs the native rate of a slow signal keeps R.signals instead.
